highlights.description: JSON API & WebSocket server for remote status, policy, and process visibility with real-time updates
Single --addr flag replaces --metrics-addr/--api-addr, unifying HTTP server configuration
CI restricted to macos-latest to match the module's darwin-only build constraints

breaking.description: Removed --metrics-addr and --api-addr; use --addr for both --metrics and --api

added.description: JSON API server: GET /api/status, /api/policies, /api/policies/{name}, /api/processes, /api/processes/{name}, POST /api/terminate
WebSocket endpoint (GET /api/ws) broadcasting status updates and termination events
--api flag to enable the JSON API server
Daemon Snapshot/Decisions/IsOnCooldown accessors and a Terminate method backing the API
Executor.Term/Kill helpers for direct SIGTERM/SIGKILL by PID
/health liveness endpoint, now registered whenever --metrics or --api is enabled

changed.description: --metrics and --api now share a single http.Server and ServeMux instead of a dedicated metrics-only server

fixed.description: Restrict diagnostic and config file writes to 0600 permissions
Suppress gosec false positives on integer-derived exec args with justification comments
Drop unused error return from captureSamples
Widen the diagnostics timestamp test tolerance to reduce flakes on slow CI runners

dependencies.description: Add github.com/gorilla/websocket for the WebSocket API

build.description: Restrict Go CI, Lint, and SAST workflows to macos-latest

documentation.description: UI PRD, TRD, PLAN, and ROADMAP specs for the JSON API/WebSocket/TUI work
JSON API section in the README
MkDocs Material documentation site scaffolded under docs/

highlights.description: macOS system health daemon that detects and mitigates runaway processes
Dual-trigger monitoring: periodic checks plus immediate checks when load exceeds threshold
Cedar policy engine for formal policy evaluation with composable rules

added.description: TOML configuration with custom Duration type and policy definitions
macOS libproc bindings via cgo for process enumeration (`proc_listpids`, `proc_pidinfo`, `proc_pidpath`)
macOS sysctl bindings for load average, CPU count, and memory metrics
Structured logging utilities with slog integration
System snapshot collection with parent name resolution
Cedar-based policy engine with priority-ordered evaluation
Parent process filtering: `parent_process` and `exclude_parents` conditions
Diagnostic snapshot capture: top, ps, process tree, stack samples
Prometheus metrics endpoint with custom registry
System metrics: load average (1m, 5m, 15m), CPU count, memory total/free
Process metrics: total count, count by name
Policy metrics: evaluations, triggers, actions by policy
Termination metrics: SIGTERM and SIGKILL counts by policy and process
Dual-trigger monitoring daemon: periodic timer + load threshold trigger
Cooldown tracking to prevent notification storms
Graceful termination: SIGTERM first, then SIGKILL after grace period
Application orchestration layer for CLI integration
Cobra CLI with `run`, `check`, `validate`, `version` commands
CLI flags: `--dry-run`, `--metrics`, `--metrics-addr`, `--config`, `--verbose`
JSON and text output formats for `check` command

tests.description: Comprehensive unit tests for config, logging, collector, policy, daemon, diagnostics, and metrics packages

documentation.description: README with installation, configuration, CLI reference, metrics, diagnostics, and architecture

build.description: Go module initialization with cedar-go, go-toml/v2, prometheus, cobra dependencies
Makefile with build, test, lint, install, and launchd targets

infrastructure.description: GitHub Actions workflows for CI: build, lint, test, CodeQL SAST
Dependabot configuration for Go modules and GitHub Actions

fixed.description: Use `cedar.EntityMap` instead of undefined `cedar.Entities` in policy engine
